title: Indicator sum bounded by the positive-part sum
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite type and let $a : \alpha \to \bbr$ be a real-valued function. For every subset $S \subseteq \alpha$,
\[
\sum_{x \in S} a(x) \;\le\; \sum_{x \in \alpha} \max\bigl(a(x),\,0\bigr).
\]
hypotheses_covered: a is a real-valued function on α
S is a subset of α
replaced:
For any function $a : \alpha \to \mathbb{R}$ on a finite type $\alpha$ and any set $S
\subseteq \alpha$,
$\sum_{x \in S} a(x) \le \sum_{x : \alpha} \max(a(x), 0)$.
